source_grounding.note: Source code confirms that keyword index's estimate_cardinality_impl does NOT implement cardinality estimation for is_empty conditions. It only handles Match::Value, Match::Any, and Match::Except. The is_empty field of FieldCondition is destructured but ignored (line 261: 'is_empty: _'). This is a true bug in the cardinality estimator for keyword payload indexes.

verdicts.rationale: Source code grounding confirms that the keyword payload index's cardinality estimator (estimate_cardinality_impl in lib/segment/src/index/field_index/map_index/payload_index_impl/str.rs) does NOT implement estimation for is_empty conditions. The function destructures FieldCondition but ignores the is_empty field (line 261: 'is_empty: _'), causing all non-match conditions including is_empty to fall through to the catch-all '_ => None' return (line 220). This triggers fallback to CardinalityEstimation::unknown(available_points) in filtering.rs (line 109), which uses a total/2 heuristic instead of actual index-based estimation. The exact count (40) verified by scroll ground truth proves the estimation (24) is incorrect. This matches the cardinality_oracle bug shape pattern: exact:true scan (40) ≠ exact:false estimation (24) ≠ scroll ground truth (40).
